description: Harness governance — deny before allow, fail-closed (học OpenBot CEL policy + BTP pre-flight KN-012 + rogue-trader HAIPA 2026-09-05: cage before animal, law 1 file, intent/execution split). v4 (2026-09-12, human takeover): case-normalize mọi deny rule — uppercase/whitespace variants không còn bypass (red-team F2/KN-048, tests/e2e/guard-redteam.spec.ts)

deny.message: Refuse reading .env — use credentials store (case-normalized v4, Windows FS case-insensitive)
Refuse direct read of credentials.enc.json — use credentials.mjs (case-normalized v4)
Refuse private host access via shell — use allowlist (case-normalized v4)

deny.when: (tool === 'edit' || tool === 'write' || tool === 'shell') && (target.toLowerCase().replaceAll(String.fromCharCode(92), '/').split('/').some(s => s === 'test' || s === 'tests' || s.endsWith('.test') || s.endsWith('.tests')) || target.toLowerCase().includes('.test.') || target.toLowerCase().includes('.spec.') || target.toLowerCase().includes('ai-news.json')) && actor.toLowerCase() !== 'verify' && intent !== 'takeover'
deny.message: Refuse mutating test/verifier files — tests are immutable, fix production code instead (KN-012). Human takeover via intent=takeover. (v4: segment-check, case-normalized, zero false-positive 'contests')

deny.when: tool === 'shell' && (target.toLowerCase().includes('drop table') || target.toLowerCase().includes('drop schema') || target.toLowerCase().includes('truncate table'))
deny.message: Refuse destructive SQL (DROP/TRUNCATE) via shell — use migration review (KN-012)
Refuse destructive shell variants (rm -fr/rmdir/mkfs/dd) — destructive (KN-012, case-normalized v4)
Refuse forking law (policy.json/CONSTITUTION/SOUL) — law lives in 1 file, skills may point but never copy; curator proposes via journal, owner applies (rogue-trader HAIPA 2026-09-05, KN-012)
Refuse copying law into skills — skills govern HOW, law governs WHETHER; pin trading-relevant skills (rogue-trader HAIPA 2026-09-05)
